title: Spring Boot services
description: External configuration, transaction boundaries and integration checks for Spring Boot applications.

rules.instruction: Bind related application settings using the project's typed configuration classes. Keep environment values and secrets in approved external providers.
rules.verification: Start the app with representative settings and confirm the effective values. Test invalid required settings through the normal startup path.

rules.instruction: For dependent writes, identify the transaction boundary and the rollback conditions. If using Spring proxy-based transactions, call the transactional entry point through the managed bean.
rules.verification: Verify a failure during the operation with the managed application context. Read the persisted state after the request without wrapping the test itself in the transaction under review.

rules.instruction: Choose a focused HTTP test for route binding and responses and a full context test when the change crosses service boundaries.
rules.verification: Check that actual configuration and integration dependencies produce the expected outcome in the project's test environment.
